content: Caching for statuslines: official docs endorse temp-file cache keyed by session_id (stable per session, unique across sessions; do NOT use $$ which changes per invocation), with mtime-based TTL (~5s) checked via stat -c %Y || stat -f %m ordering (Linux form first). Community scripts cache slow external data (usage API) at ~/.claude/*.json with 300s TTL and file locking for concurrent sessions. Claude Code cancels in-flight scripts on new triggers, so slow scripts cause blank/stale lines — everything must complete well under ~300ms.
